comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
Does anyone know how to obtain this?
Can it be used to make Sagaris?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Tch. I guess nobody else is going to answer this one? Well, first up, stats:

Axe-type class weapon (obviously)
80 Attack
75 Durability
+1 Swordplay
+1 Sword Mastery
+1 Assault
10k fame to equip.

Now, as previously discussed under Secret Edict Award ...

To craft this weapon, R15 Casting is required, along with x10 Mysterious Gold and the use of a statue in a specific hidden room of the Labyrinth dungeon (the one with the Stamina restoring statue). There you'll find the recipe you need, along with one for Statue of Ariadne (optional but potentially useful to your quest for a Minotaur Axe/Sagaris; see its page for further details).

IIRC, a 100 attk version of this weapon is possible with Great Success, but it's arguably more useful if transformed through Transmutation Alchemy to make the Sagaris (which gives the R15 Stamina Loss Reduction EX effect for the user and any fleets they join/form). Remember, any GS stats will be lost when you subject equipment to the process of Transmutation Alchemy.

Actually finding that room is nearly as tough as obtaining the required M.gold and casting levels, though. I wish you and anyone else who desires such a powerful weapon in their arsenal great success. Cheers.

comments.body: I have been grinding the labyrinth for the past few days and after an estimated 500 sections (many multiple runs) i still haven't found the room. I have seeker of the unknown title equipped too, but I guess I'll have to carry on.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: For what it's worth, I saw a player named Vasanta equipped with this or the Sagaris sitting in bazaar mode by the Seville Company Admin Office. He didn't respond to my private message, but this does at least prove the weapon is possible to make. I'll update any further info/tips if I come across something; I hope others will do so as well. Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Good to hear. Does your friend recall anything in particular about how they found that room? Were they running a TH, did they do all blue/white torches, or just one kind, no torches at all, about how deep in they were before it appeared, if titles or items played a part in it... you know, those kinds of things?

comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
My friend confirmed that the axe can be crafted in the same room where you can restore Health Points. My friend wasn't running a TH quest.

Wsp, did you go into hidden passage while doing those 500 sections? The room is in the hidden passage :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I can't speak for Wsp, but I know others who've tried diving into hidden passages without any success for close to two weeks now, much to their frustration. It may just be a RNG thing, though. After all, the Minotaur hardly ever showed up; why would his axe recipe be any different?

Tip: I recall the statue recipe/stamina recovery room in Atlantis had a memo message of being a 'room with a mysterious air', or something like that. On the offhand chance you ever get a hidden room memo in the Labyrinth with a similar message, it should be the same result. Again, my thanks to you and your friend for additional confirmation. Cheers.

Good tip, Bael. For those unaware: at the time of the older comments, it seems as if the chance to encounter the recipe room was extremely low since many (and I do mean many) players I spoke to at that time had difficulty in locating it.

But at some point the chance to find that room went back up to a more reasonable rate, and there have been no real problems in finding it since. Cheers, and may your rowing grind go well.
